closures.reason: The candidate assumes ap_pipeline_reset() restores an immutable pre-tuning configuration. In the supported control contract, ap_pipeline_apply_tuning() updates pipeline->cfg, ap_pipeline_get_config() returns that current effective configuration, and ap_pipeline_reset() reinitializes from the current pipeline->cfg. Rewinding runtime tuning projection on RESET would therefore diverge from worker state.
The single authorized candidate failed frozen Hosted Real AEC movement and echo-path-change hard-negative gates; the committed closure exhausts the candidate budget and keeps the shipping baseline.

The branch is an unmerged alternative implementation of the v2.3.23 near-input alignment reuse. PR #287 implemented the same optimization on the canonical validation path and merged to main; subsequent validation releases through v2.3.36 build on that merged implementation. Retain this exact SHA as closure evidence and garbage-collect the live ref rather than rebasing or merging the duplicate candidate.

Current main no longer references that secret, and current Hosted Real Audio/AEC validation is green without this branch.
